description.text: Chinese Government Scholarship-Silk Road Scholarship Program is a full scholarshipestablished by Ministry of Education of China to support Chinese universities to attractoutstanding international students from Belt and Road Countries to study in China. CUG isone of the prestigious universities designated to undertake this program to recruitundergraduate students for studying Bachelor Programs.Full scholarship, including tuition,on-campus accommodation, living allowance inChina. comprehensive medical insurance.Priority CountriesVietnam,Laos,Thailand,Russia,Uzbekistan, Tajikistan.Sierra Leone, Kenya, Madagascar, Turkey and othercountries participating the Belt and Road Initiative

duration.text: The Exploration Engineering of Mineral Resources at China University of Geosciences is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1:Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English)2:Notarized highest diploma (notarized in Chinese or English, Prospective diplomarecipients should submit official document issued by your current school to prove noonly your current student status, but also the expected degree certificate and graduatiordate, original certificate must be presented when you come to register);3:Notarized complete transcripts of each semester of high school (notarized in Chinese olEnglish)or Scores of an internationally recognized standardized test / universityentrance exam (Such as the SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/lB, etc);4:A Study Plan with a minimum of 200 words (in Chinese or English);5:Two Recommendation Letters (in Chinese or English)6:A photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English (theoriginal copy shall be kept by the applicant). The form is designed by the Chinese

requirements.text: 1：The applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen in good physical and mental health.2：Applicant should be a high school diploma holder under the age of 25 when applyingfor Bachelor's programs.3：This scholarship program only supports Chinese-taught bachelor program. Applicantsmust pass HSK3 or above.
